landing.heroDesc: Pick any YouTube video in Spanish, French, or English. We add clickable subtitles. Tap a word and get the definition, translation, and examples instantly. Save it to your vocabulary. That's Languni.
landing.problemH2: Why most language apps leave you stuck.
landing.problem1Desc: Flashcard apps drill vocabulary without context. You memorize words in isolation and forget them within days because your brain has nothing to anchor them to.
landing.problem2Desc: Textbook dialogues feel scripted because they are. Nobody talks like that. Real conversations use slang, idioms, and natural pacing that scripted lessons ignore.
landing.problem3Desc: Content is either too basic to be useful or too advanced to follow. Without proper level matching, you're stuck in a cycle of frustration or boredom.
landing.problem4Desc: Regular subtitles are read-only. You see unknown words fly by and can't pause to look them up without breaking your flow and losing the moment.
landing.solutionText: Languni solves every one of these problems with one simple idea:
landing.solutionHighlight: learn from the videos people actually watch.
landing.feat1Desc: Watch real YouTube videos with synced, clickable subtitles. Tap any word mid-video: it pauses, shows you what you need, and you carry on.
landing.feat2Desc: One tap on any word gives you the definition, pronunciation, translation into your native language, and real example sentences, without leaving the video.
landing.feat3Desc: Save any video to your personal library and come back to it anytime. Build a collection of content you enjoy and keep learning from it.
landing.feat4Desc: Every word you save gets stored with the exact sentence you heard it in. Review your full list anytime: definition, translation, and the video it came from.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Create an account and use every available Languni feature. No payment, no card, no subscription.
landing.premiumFeat1: Watch as many videos as you want
landing.footerCta: Start learning from real content today.

about.metaDescription: Meet Daniel Kloutse, the founder of Languni. A software engineer from Togo who moved to the US and built a language learning app powered by YouTube.
about.p1: I'm from Togo and I moved to the US almost 2 years ago knowing English barely. When I got the opportunity to come here I started to work on my English and practice more. What helped me a lot was YouTube. I was spending a lot of time watching vlog videos and react videos in English to get familiar with the accent, the speed of talking and to learn new words too. It took a while to get to a decent level and feel comfortable talking with people. YouTube had a huge impact on that.
about.p2: I was a software engineer in Togo before coming to the US and I thought I could build something around YouTube to make it easier for people to learn a language while having fun watching any YouTube video. It took me a while to do that. When you are moving to another country and trying to get things settled down it is not easy at all. But I found time aside to build this project. This current version is a prototype to test if my idea can work and see if people will use it. There will be more features coming. I have a lot of ideas around my main features that can help everybody learn different languages while watching a YouTube video. For now I just stick to 3. English and French that I know and understand very well, and Spanish too. I will add more languages in the future.
about.p3a: is just a fun name I found for the project. In the beginning I was thinking about Linguini, the spaghetti, as a funny name for the project. But in the middle I changed it to
about.p4: This is a fun project. I built it just to see what I am capable of and to have fun. If you like it you can reach me on the contact page or on my DM on Twitter or LinkedIn.
